title: Show ownership in a behavioral interview
summary: Kể STAR story có hành động cá nhân, kết quả đo được và reflection.

exercises.question: Chi tiết nào cải thiện câu trả lời nhiều nhất?
options: I introduced a rollback checklist that reduced recovery time from 40 to 12 minutes.

performanceTask.title: Tell an ownership story
performanceTask.scenario: Interviewer hỏi về lúc bạn chủ động xử lý một production problem.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, trả lời cold question mà chưa xem model/chunks.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, giữ situation/task ngắn, làm rõ hành động của bạn, result đo được và lesson.
performanceTask.modelResponse: During a payment rollback, recovery took forty minutes because ownership was unclear. My immediate responsibility was to coordinate the recovery, but I also treated the unclear ownership as a process problem that needed a follow-up action. After the incident, I created a rollback checklist and named a rollback owner so the next response would have an explicit path. The result was measurable: the next recovery took twelve minutes instead of forty. That comparison matters because it shows the effect of the change, not just that the team worked hard. Looking back, I learned that ownership has two parts: helping resolve the immediate incident and improving the process that made recovery slow. I would keep both the action and the measured result clear in the interview answer.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, kể incident queue backlog mới; rút gọn context và làm rõ I-action/result.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Trong 90–120 giây và không xem model/chunks, kể lúc bạn chủ động ngăn certificate expiry thành incident.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, kể một ownership story mới về data-quality risk bằng STAR và evidence.

artifacts.title: Risk facts
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. The certificate was due to expire in nine days; no owner was assigned; you added a rotation job, alert and runbook; renewal completed with six days remaining.

rubric.label: Concise STAR structure
rubric.description: Keeps situation and task brief enough to foreground action.

rubric.label: Personal ownership
rubric.description: Uses specific I-statements for decisions and actions.

rubric.label: Result and learning
rubric.description: Uses the measured result from the current evidence packet and clearly frames the lesson as personal reflection.

training.question: What proves ownership?
training.feedback: Stress I and the action verbs; do not overuse we.

audio.text: As a result, p ninety-five fell to five hundred milliseconds.

training.question: What stays brief?
training.feedback: Keep situation short so action remains prominent.

audio.text: I introduced alerts and tested the runbook.

training.question: How many actions are named?
training.feedback: Keep final sounds in alerts and tested audible.

audio.text: What I learned was to assign an owner before release.

training.question: What part of STAR is this?

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn I + action verb; giữ âm cuối trong profiled, proposed, alerts, tested.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Mờ chủ thể/action khiến ownership nghe như công sức chung không xác định.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Tạo một thought group riêng cho AS A RESULT + con số.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Con số chìm làm evidence khó được interviewer bắt kịp.
